title: Presentation Sensitivity in Typed Decision Models for Subjective Text Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2611.06384v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Typed decision models offer structured choices, scores, and probabilities for low-cost automated evaluation. We present a controlled audit of presentation sensitivity in Jev, Clef Flash, and Perplexity Decider across native choice and score interfaces. Across six datasets with 9,000 multiply annotated humor, helpfulness, and summarization items, we collect 702,000 judgments under interventions that vary positions, identifiers, authorship claims, endorsements, decision framing, and rating rubrics while preserving the evaluated texts. Jev's second-position probability advantage reaches 6.11 percentage points on summaries; reversing reader endorsements changes Perplexity's selected humor text on 40.40% of pairs; and rejection framing reduces Clef's summary agreement with human preferences by 23.36 points. translated_title: 主观文本评估中类型化决策模型的呈现敏感性
translated_abstract: 类型化决策模型为低成本的自动化评估提供了结构化的选择、分数和概率。我们对Jev、Clef Flash和Perplexity Decider在原生选择与评分界面中的呈现敏感性进行了一项受控审计。实验涵盖六个数据集，包含9,000个经过多次标注的幽默、有用性和摘要类条目；在保持被评估文本不变的前提下，我们通过改变位置、标识符、作者声明、背书、决策框架和评分标准等干预措施，共收集了702,000个判断结果。结果显示：Jev在摘要任务上的第二位置概率优势达到6.11个百分点；反转读者背书会使Perplexity在40.40%的文本配对中改变所选的幽默文本；拒绝式框架使Clef的摘要选择与人类偏好的一致性下降23.36个百分点。评分格式也会导致分数水平的变化，但通常能保留原有排名。基于这些发现，可重复性、呈现鲁棒性……
tldr: 该论文通过70.2万次受控判断审计发现，用于主观文本评估的类型化决策模型对呈现方式高度敏感——即使被评估文本不变，位置、背书和决策框架的改变也会使模型选择发生最高达40.40%的显著偏移。
en_tdlr: This paper conducts a controlled audit of 702,000 judgments showing that typed decision models for subjective text evaluation are highly presentation-sensitive: even with unchanged texts, shifts in position, endorsements, and decision framing alter model selections by up to 40.40%.
